'''Lanklyn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]] Lanklyn was to deliver a frozen [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] body of a Republic spy [[Grik Sonosan]] to [[Darth Baras]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. When arriving at [[Docking Bay 12 (Kaas City)|Docking Bay 12]] of [[Dromund Kaas spaceport|Kaas City spaceport]], he was to wait for Baras's [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] and help deliver it to him.

However when the apprentice arrived, Lanklyn and his men were ambushed by two thugs, [[Slestack]] who was to capture the body and deliver it to his master; and [[TuMarr]] who wanted it for himself. However whilst Slestack, TuMarr, and their men were distracted fighting each other; Lanklyn and his men were able to quickly deliver the body without getting harmed. The two thugs and their crew quickly killed each other and Baras's apprentice went to report about the successful mission.

[[File:BarasKillsLanklyn-SWTOR.png|left|thumb|Lanklyn was Force-choked to death by Darth Baras.]]
Lanklyn and Baras's apprentice [[Hunt for Xerender|met again]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] where Lanklyn was tracking the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Xerender]] for Darth Baras. Lanklyn went out to search for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with his men, but got himself captured and was only saved because [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Slinte]] provided the Sith with Lanklyn's last known location. Lanklyn reported that Xerender had a squad of [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] commandos at his disposal, which he used to cover his tracks as he approached his true objective: the Jedi Master [[Wyellett]]. Lanklyn, Slinte and the Sith later gathered to report Darth Baras on their progress, but during the holocall, Xerender was able to tap into the message. Angered at the failure, Baras Force-choked Lanklyn, despite being on the other side of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and promoted Ensign Slinte to Commander of his operations on Hoth.
